title: "Units can't move to base" is not enforced. With Minotaur Reckoner in play (base), a readied friendly Chemtech Enforcer at a battlefield was offered `standardMove {destination:"base"}` in the available-moves list and the move executed successfully (log: "dev moved Chemtech Enforcer to base").
expected: minotaur-reckoner.ts:16-25 grants custom keyword "NoMoveToBase" via static grant-keyword, but `grep -rn NoMoveToBase packages/riftbound-engine/src` returns nothing. standard-move.ts condition (lines 54-95) only checks zone/owner/exhausted/surcharge for toBase moves, and the enumerator (lines 170-202) unconditionally offers destination:"base" for every ready battlefield unit. No reader of the keyword exists, so the restriction is never enforced.
observed: Server state showed the static aura working at the data level (both units carried grantedKeywords:[{keyword:"NoMoveToBase",duration:"static"}]), but the move to base was enumerated and succeeded. `grep NoMoveToBase` in packages/riftbound-engine/src finds no reader — the custom keyword granted by the card (packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/sfd/minotaur-reckoner.ts) is never consulted by standard-move validation/enumeration.
